plugins.name: adage
plugins.description: Agent traces become reflexes: Adage learns the paths your agents take in each repository and tells them, deterministically, what to do next, and, once you allow a step, does it for them. Three binaries (adage, adage-exec, adage-train) are bundled for macOS and Linux and checked against their checksums before they run; nothing is downloaded. Windows hooks are untested and execute nothing.
